verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions lets users write YAML workflows compatible with GitHub Actions, and webhooks support custom workflows. Together these suggest event-driven automation. However, the evidence never explicitly documents event triggers (such as on push or on issue) or a rule-definition model, so event triggering is only implied by the GitHub Actions compatibility claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-trigger types and conditions, non-CI automation rules (e.g., issue or label automation), hands-on or independent corroboration of event-triggered workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
Workflow and action syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions.
Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
